connection.title: Connection
connection.errorPortNotFound: Port {{port}} not found. Is the machine powered on and the USB cable plugged in?
connection.errorPortBusy: Port {{port}} is not accessible: it may already be in use by another program or another CNCStream window.

macros.unhomedMessage: The macro "{{name}}" uses machine coordinates (G53), but no homing ($H) has been done since connecting. If the machine position is not reliable, the machine will go to the wrong place, up to the end stop. Home the machine first, or run anyway if you are sure of its position.

console.clearTitle: Clear the console and today's log
console.logsTitle: Open the log folder (one file per day, 7 days kept)

jog.title: Jogging
jog.stepTitle: Distance moved per click in incremental mode.
jog.feedTitle: Jog movement speed (all axes). Limited by machine specifications ($110 X, $111 Y, $112 Z).
jog.keyboardShortcuts:
Arrows: X/Y movement
Page Up/Down: Z movement
[ / ]: decrease / increase step
Continuous mode: hold key for continuous movement

zeroGoto.title: Moves
zeroGoto.probeFailedMsg: The probe did not detect a surface within the search range.
zeroGoto.probeCircuitOpen: Step 1: place the probe on the cutter to test the circuit
zeroGoto.probeCircuitContact: Contact detected between the probe and the cutter
zeroGoto.probeZTitle: Automatically detect the workpiece surface and set Z0. Requires circuit test first.
zeroGoto.probeThicknessTitle: Exact thickness of your touch plate, measured with calipers (0.1–50 mm)
zeroGoto.safeHeightTitle: Z clearance height for manual operations only: Go to XY Zero, retract after Probe Z, and probe offset calculation. Has no effect during G-code job execution.
zeroGoto.homeHint: Homing: redo it after every power-up, before any machine-coordinate macro.
zeroGoto.safeHeightHint: Z clearance before an XY move
zeroGoto.probeZHint: Available once the circuit is tested.

overrides.title: Overrides
overrides.feedTooltip: Adjusts cutting feed rate (G1/G2/G3) from 10% to 200% of the programmed value.
overrides.spindleTooltip: Adjusts spindle speed (PWM mode only) from 10% to 200% of the programmed RPM.
overrides.rapidTooltip: Adjusts G0 rapid positioning speed: 25%, 50%, or 100%. Only 3 fixed levels supported by GRBL.

settings.title: Settings
settings.travelTitle: Shows the area the machine can reach as a dashed box (read from GRBL: $130, $131, $132)
settings.travelValuesTitle: Read from GRBL on every connection. Enter it here to see the reachable area without a machine.
settings.homingMaskTitle: ON: this axis homes towards the negative side (a bit set in GRBL's $23). OFF: towards the positive side. Read from GRBL on connection.
settings.toolFromFile: Diameter read from the loaded file ({{diameter}} mm). Close the file to set it by hand.
settings.toolTitle: Diameter of the cutter shown in the 3D view
settings.logTitle: Records the exchanges with the machine in a file, one per day (off by default)

dro.workPosTitle: Work position (WPos) — coordinates relative to the workpiece zero (G54). Click to show MachinePos.
dro.machinePosTitle: Machine position (MPos / G53) — absolute coordinates from the physical reference point (home). Click to show WorkPos.

spindle.title: Spindle
spindle.ccwTitle: Counter-clockwise (M4) — used for tapping or reverse-cut tools
spindle.tooltipPwm: The spindle is driven by GRBL's PWM signal. RPM values and overrides control the actual speed.
spindle.tooltipRelay: The spindle is on a relay output (ON/OFF). Actual speed is always maximum, overrides have no effect on physical speed.
spindle.tooltipManual: Speed is set by a manual potentiometer. Displayed values are indicative (GRBL), actual speed depends on physical setting.
spindle.modeBadgeRelay: Relay mode: ON/OFF only, speed not controlled
spindle.modeBadgeManual: Manual mode: speed set by physical potentiometer

gcode.pausedOnError: Job paused: the machine rejected command #{{line}} "{{command}}" ({{error}}). Resume skips it, Stop cancels the job.
gcode.probeWarningMsg: Z0 has not been set by probing in this session. Start the job without probing?
gcode.spindleWarningMsg: The spindle is not running. You can start it from here (cutter clear of the workpiece), or start the job without it.
gcode.spindleReadyMsg: Spindle is running. Start the job?

alarm.title: Alarm {{code}}: {{message}}
alarm.note: The machine is locked. Unlock it, then home again before resuming: the machine position is no longer reliable.
